messages:
maria: Kicking off deploy for service-llm-router. Plan: roll v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0. Feature flag `llm-routing-v4` to be enabled at 5% canary, then ramp to 20% over 30m if telemetry is green. Pin model variant `model-a.q8` for the deploy. Release window 23:00-01:00 UTC. deploy-bot, preflight?

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: CI ✅, infra capacity ✅ (gpu-pool eu-west spare 6), canary target healthy. No blocking alerts. Ready to start canary. Command: `/deploy service-llm-router v2.4.0 --canary`

maria: starting canary now. i'll watch p50/p95, token-cost, and error-rate. tag me if anything >1.3x baseline.

carla: quick note — nightly batch jobs in eu-west are currently running, we've seen GPU util spikes earlier. recommend holding ramp at 5% for 15m and sample before going to 20%.

tom: +1 on hold. also suggest we enable the preemptive degrade rule so flag drops to 0% automatically if p95 > 1.5x or token-cost > 1.4x for 2 consecutive minutes.

maria: good call. @deploy-bot can you attach preemptive-degrade policy to this FF and hold at 5% for 15m? update release notes with the pinned model mention.

jen: adding: add a temporary metric alert for `llm.token_cost_per_request` to the canary dashboard and notify #oncall if it spikes. I'll update the runbook.

deploy-bot: Action log:
```
[1712348989] deploy-bot: starting canary for service-llm-router v2.4.0
[1712348992] featureflag: llm-routing-v4 -> 5% (cohort: canary-a)
[1712348993] pinned_model: model-a.q8
[1712349000] attached policy: preemptive-degrade(p95>1.5x OR token_cost>1.4x, window=2m)
```

deploy-bot: metric snapshot at +5m: p50 unchanged, p95 up 1.6x in canary cohort, token_cost_per_request +1.7x. Alert: `llm.cost-regression` triggered and routed to #oncall.

maria: saw the alert. p95 and token-cost both above thresholds. aborting ramp. Tom — please proceed with disabling the flag and rolling back routing to v2.3.1 behavior.

tom: executing immediate rollback and disabling flag. done.

deploy-bot: Rollback log:
```
[1712349075] deploy-bot: disabling featureflag llm-routing-v4 -> 0%
[1712349080] routing: revert to stable route (v2.3.1 handler)
[1712349090] unpin: keeping model-a.q8 pinned until follow-up testing complete
[1712349100] deploy-bot: rollback complete, canary traffic restored to baseline
```

maria: confirmed — traffic is back to stable routes, error rates normal, cost back down. Adding an incident note and updating release notes: https://go/release-notes/2024-llm-router-v2-4 (placeholder).

carla: leaving a short ops note: we'll experiment with shorter KV cache warmup and smaller batch sizes in the next canary to reduce token churn. Also schedule the batch jobs to a different window for next run.

jen: I'll open the postmortem ticket and attach the metric snapshots + the deploy-bot logs. Assigning to @maria and @tom for follow-up action items. Thanks everyone — we kept the rollback quick, good work. :handshake:

maria: thanks all. follow-up checklist: 1) tweak canary resource profile, 2) add token-cost regression test to CI, 3) reschedule nightly batch in eu-west. Will sync tomorrow in the release sync meeting.
